_meta.state: R1 research and initial draft; excluded from publication

scope: Only completed Formula 1 World Championship Grands Prix at Lusail International Circuit: 2021, 2023, 2024, and 2025. Do not treat 2022, which had no Qatar round on the FIA calendar, as a held race; do not merge Sprint results into the Grand Prix table.

schedule_2026.boundary: Official timetable is subject to change; article states only the scheduled race start. This is a standard weekend with no F1 Sprint on the published timetable.

editorial_boundaries: Do not infer 2026 winning probability, strategy, weather, DRS configuration, tyre behaviour, or overtaking difficulty from four past Grands Prix.
Pole position is qualifying first place and is not interchangeable with the final grid position or any Sprint result.
Race winner means the Grand Prix final classification, not the Sprint winner.
